sentences.speaker: Elle Woods
sentences.text: Ms. Windham, on the morning of your father's murder, you stated under sworn oath that you were in the shower during the gunshots.

sentences.speaker: Chutney Windham
sentences.text: Yes, I got a perm that morning and was washing my hair in the master bath.

sentences.speaker: Elle Woods
sentences.text: Anyone who has ever gotten a perm knows that washing your hair within forty-eight hours deactivates the ammonium thioglycolate and destroys the curls.

sentences.speaker: Chutney Windham
sentences.text: I didn't mean to shoot him, I thought it was Brooke walking through the door!

sentences.speaker: Judge
sentences.text: Bailiff, arrest that witness for first-degree murder; the defendant Brooke Windham is acquitted and free to go.
